metadata.title: A comparison theorem for the planar strip isoperimetric problem
metadata.abstract: We consider the isoperimetric problem with planar density equal to 1 on a horizontal strip and to a constant $\lambda>1$ outside the strip. We resolve a conjecture made by Cañete-Miranda Jr-Vittone by showing that every four-arc region admits a three-arc competitor with the same weighted area and strictly smaller weighted perimeter. The argument applies to every $\lambda>1$ and gives an explicit positive lower bound for the perimeter difference.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 条带密度等周问题的四弧排除
analysis.workSummary: 对水平条带内密度一、外部常密度 λ>1 的平面，证明每个四弧区域都有同加权面积但更小加权周长的三弧竞争者，并给出正差值下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 对全部 λ>1 解决相应 Cañete–Miranda–Vittone 猜想。
analysis.limitations: 比较针对指定条带密度与四弧结构，不能直接推广到任意不连续密度。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露以 GPT-6-Astra 协调多个模型的程序辅助发现中间结果、发展证明策略及 Lean 形式化，另用 AI 检查形式化与数学表述是否一致；最终数学论证由作者核验，稿件由作者撰写。
